name: ai-agent-ecosystem
description: Reusable engineering workflows and capability-safe skills for a coordinated multi-agent software team.

interface.shortDescription: 19 reusable engineering skills and safe multi-agent workflows
interface.longDescription: A reusable engineering skill suite covering discovery, architecture, task decomposition, API and database design, debugging, TDD, code review, deployment readiness, capability preflight, project memory, and handoffs. Codex custom agent profiles remain available through the native adapter installer.
